An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''stormtrooper''' served at the Imperial [[Kalist Base|Kalist VI labor colony]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Circa [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] attempted to stop two [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], [[Breg]] and [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], from escaping the camp. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] shot and mortally wounded Breg, but Ralter shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the trooper in turn.
